author: Crypto Cronkite
title: The Week Ahead: FOMC rate decision
dek: What is on the calendar for the week of September 14: scheduled events only, no predictions.
key_fact: Wednesday, September 16: FOMC rate decision. The Federal Open Market Committee meets Tuesday and Wednesday; the rate decision lands Wednesday at 2:00 p.m. Eastern with a press conference at 2:30. This meeting carries a Summary of Economic Projections, so the dot plot updates.
body: This is the week's known calendar: scheduled dates only, published in advance by the institutions involved. What happens at them is the week's news; this story only tells you when to watch.

Wednesday, September 16: FOMC rate decision. The Federal Open Market Committee meets Tuesday and Wednesday; the rate decision lands Wednesday at 2:00 p.m. Eastern with a press conference at 2:30. This meeting carries a Summary of Economic Projections, so the dot plot updates.
